messages:
Devon (Eng Oncall): taking primary for the 22:00-06:00 UTC shift. quick checklist before handoff:
- pd escalation policies verified?
- grafana dashboards editable?
- aws assume-role works for temp-oncall?

Maria (SRE): noted. i'm secondary until 02:00 UTC then i'll spin primary. can someone confirm pagerduty assignment and that both of us are in the rotation?

incident-bot: ALERT created: HIGH - api.latency.p99 > 1200ms service=redwood-api region=us-east-1
• incident id: INC-24321
• triggered at: 22:03 UTC
• paging: primary on-call (Devon)

Devon (Eng Oncall): saw the bot. i'm on it — triage in progress. Maria, you can take the customer comms channel if we need to escalate.

Jake (SRE): quick access note — pd CLI token for backups rotated this morning. Devon, make sure your local ~/.pdrc is current or use PD web until i push a new token.

Devon (Eng Oncall): thanks. i can't use the pd CLI right now (403). could be token. can someone confirm PD web escalation page is reachable?

Aly (Ops): pd web is up for me. i can add you as a temporary responder to INC-24321 if you need it. do you want me to add Maria too? :thumbsup:

Devon (Eng Oncall): yes add Maria. also need grafana edit access for the api dashboards (to annotate and silence some noisy panels).

Lina (Security): hold on grafana edits. are you planning to modify dashboard panels or just add annotations/silences? if edits, we need approval logged in the audit ticket.

Devon (Eng Oncall): just annotations and a silence on the noisy alert rule for the duration of the incident. i'll avoid changing panels.

Lina (Security): ok annotate+silence is fine. Aly — please grant "Viewer+Annotate" role for these dashboards to Devon and Maria for the next 6 hours and log the grant in ticket SEC-357.

Aly (Ops): on it. i will use the team-managed role: grafana-annotator-temp. command i'll run:
```bash
# add user to team role via grafana cli
grafana-cli admin teams add-user --team grafana-annotator-temp --user "devon"
```
Will paste audit ID after.

Devon (Eng Oncall): thx. for AWS, i need to confirm i can assume the role to access the prod account for deeper traces. Maria, can you run a quick assume-role test from your laptop?

Maria (SRE): running now:
```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/temp-oncall --role-session-name devon-handoff
```
Got MFA prompt, then returned creds. i then ran:
```bash
aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/EC2 --metric-name CPUUtilization --start-time ...
```
so role works but requires MFA. Devon, make sure your YubiKey is ready or you have OTP.

Devon (Eng Oncall): yubi is with me. thanks. any known coverage gaps for APAC overnight?

Jake (SRE): APAC has partial coverage; we rely on the follow-the-sun handoff but nothing automated for region failover. if the incident needs cross-region failover, ping infra to open an incident bridge and set priority. runbook section: runbooks/region-failover.md (link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/region-failover).

Devon (Eng Oncall): copy. i'll check the runbook now. Maria, if this gets escalated I'll need you to stand up a triage bridge. can you confirm you have conference bridge creds?

Maria (SRE): confirmed. bridge creds are in 1Password item "Oncall Bridges" and the OTP works. i also have the escalation playbook open.

Aly (Ops): grafana change done, audit id SEC-AUD-78421. Devon and Maria have grafana-annotator-temp role until 06:00 UTC. PD responders updated: Devon, Maria added.

Devon (Eng Oncall): i see the grafana annotation button now. adding note to the API dashboard: "INC-24321 - p99 latency spike, silenced noisy rule for incident duration."

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-24321 status changed to MONITORED by Devon (primary).

Jake (SRE): quick mitigation steps recorded in thread: 
1) check ingress ELBs for 5xx spike
2) tail redwood-api pods: kubectl -n prod logs -f deploy/redwood-api --since=1m
3) validate cache layer (redis) latency metrics
4) if memory leak suspected, scale up replicas and trigger canary rollback

Devon (Eng Oncall): performing step 2 now. seeing spikes and a few OOMs on pod-3. scaling replicas to 6 temporarily.

Maria (SRE): while you scale, i'll run the cold-start check on the model-serving nodes and check KV cache hit rates.

Lina (Security): one security note: if you create new IAM temporary creds, please ensure they are limited to session duration and log the request in SEC-357 as Aly did. also avoid copying creds to ephemeral shared notes.

Devon (Eng Oncall): agreed. using assume-role only, no static creds. logging actions here and in the incident ticket.

Aly (Ops): PD web update: escalation policy shows no new overrides. i added a brief note to the incident that grafana edit grant was given and audit id logged.

Devon (Eng Oncall): final handoff note for whoever picks this up later:
- primary: Devon until 02:00 UTC, then Maria primary
- secondary: Maria until 02:00 UTC, then Devon secondary (confirm in PD)
- grafana: annotate/silence granted, audit SEC-AUD-78421
- aws: assume-role works with MFA (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/temp-oncall)
- runbook links: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff and https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/region-failover
- incident ticket: INC-24321

Maria (SRE): copying final checklist to the incident ticket and will pick up as primary at 02:00 UTC. good handoff.

Devon (Eng Oncall): thanks all. closing this thread and switching to monitoring mode. ping if anything changes. :eyes:
